title: Hello
hook: Why do these chords feel like *calling the past*?
question: Got it within 3 chords? Be honest 👇

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: Home: *F minor*. A quiet, empty room.

chords.name: Ab/Eb
chords.text: The bass steps down to *E♭*. Reaching out.
